authority: Same-context analysis. Not independent review. Grants no scientific or promotion authority.
object: The headline QUESTION of Paper I, not its answers.
qoi: Which question maximizes (a) support from receipts on main, (b) sign-robustness, (c) field need, (d) consistency with the no-scalarization theorem and the benefit ledger.

current_question.statement: Which generated statements are licensed to change a scientific record - what discipline must an evidence-governed agent obey?
current_question.character: Soundness/definitional. Already answered at MECHANIZED strength for 3 mechanics (MECH-AUTHORITY-NON-ESCALATION, MECH-BOUNDED-SATURATION, MECH-NO-SCALAR-COLLAPSE per research/mechanism_benefit_ledger/ledger.json); 87 theorem heads in formal/RaklFormal.lean, axiom-audited in CI (.github/workflows/paper1-formal-proofs.yml) with a planted-failure negative control; 18 paper claims mapped (17 FULL, 1 PARTIAL) in research/paper1_formal_closure/theorem_inventory.json.

candidate_questions.question: What discipline must an evidence-governed agent obey so that generation cannot silently change a scientific record? (incumbent)
candidate_questions.sign_robustness: N/A - already answered; as a headline going forward it is definitional, not falsifiable.
candidate_questions.field_need: Partially occupied: the abstract already carves position against transactional-state, contested-knowledge and agent-publishing nearest work (sections 01b-01e, 04c, 04f). CANNOT_CHECK for post-cutoff entrants without a fresh nearest-work pass (nearest-work lane active).
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: Consistent but confined to the soundness column; the ledger's own finding is that soundness cannot carry the programme (it is satisfied by a system that never acts).

candidate_questions.question: Which hypotheses of the mechanized discipline are individually NECESSARY, and which can be dropped without losing the guarantee? (minimal-discipline frontier)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: STRONG and specifically enabled by the formalization style: formal/RaklFormal.lean deliberately passes every hypothesis as an explicit argument ('making each hypothesis an explicit argument is the faithful formalization', file header). CI already has the two ingredients a necessity audit needs: a compile gate and a planted-failure control. Exemplar necessity witnesses already exist in-file (certified_operator_may_change_canon witnesses that the certification hypothesis of no_uncertified_composition_changes_canon is load-bearing; ledger RES-MBL-002 demands exactly this class of witness).
candidate_questions.sign_robustness: SIGN-ROBUST. Every hypothesis of every headline theorem lands in one of three publishable cells: (i) necessity countermodel exists (component is load-bearing - strengthens the discipline claim), (ii) theorem survives hypothesis removal (discipline simplifies - also a result), (iii) proof-necessary but no countermodel found (honest CANNOT_CHECK cell). No outcome is a loss.
candidate_questions.field_need: Minimality analyses of mechanized hypothesis sets are routine inside formal mathematics but not, to this audit's in-repo knowledge, for agent-governance developments; that novelty wording is CANNOT_CHECK until a primary-source nearest-work pass - route to the nearest-work lane.
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: Directly services RES-MBL-002 (four mechanics lack non-vacuity witnesses). Non-compensatory by construction: each hypothesis gets its own cell; no aggregate score.

candidate_questions.question: Which discipline components carry measured weight on outcomes the mechanism does not define? (benefit column)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: PARTIAL - the ledger names the tractable external anchor for MECH-BOUNDED-SATURATION (set-completeness IoU against an external wide-research benchmark) but no such arm exists on main. The benefit_L0/L1/L2 receipts (research/benefit_L0_fcr_v1, benefit_L1_composition_v1, benefit_L2_gluing_v1; all typed PROMOTE on synthetic known-answer corpora, ladder flips pending external GovernanceSignOff) cover ladder layers whose atoms Paper I co-owns, so the column is no longer empty at mechanical-arm grade.
candidate_questions.sign_robustness: Robust if framed as a buy-and-cost frontier (the Paper 3 audit precedent); sign-risky if framed as 'governance wins'.
candidate_questions.field_need: High - benefit accounting for governance layers is the programme's own declared gap.
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: This IS the ledger's empty column. Ownership note: the benefit-saturation lane is executing this ladder; a Paper I audit should consume its receipts, not duplicate arms.

candidate_questions.sign_robustness: Robust (bounds are bounds either way) but marginal information from new families is diminishing.

candidate_questions.sign_robustness: SIGN-RISKY and outcome-provenance-risky (self-authored-outcome trap; see the retracted Paper VI 3.31x headline in the ledger's structural_trap note).

candidate_questions.question: Where does the reasoning live in an evidence-governed substrate - what is compiled into the space, what is governed at the interfaces, and what is located by failure analysis? (reasoning-location frame; operator addendum 2026-08-14)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: STRONG for the articulation itself: the compiled-reasoning claim is stated in shipped code (src/rakl/derivation.py: 'no reasoning engine in the loop, only traversal'), certificates are use-time-re-verified (src/rakl/certificates.py), interfaces are fail-closed (admit_reducer, LIFT specification), and failure analysis mechanically names the missing lemma (DerivationReport.missing; UNDERIVABLE_IN_PRINCIPLE vs AUTHORITY_BLOCKED). Articulated in docs/REASONING_LOCATION.md.
candidate_questions.sign_robustness: The frame's falsifiable projection is the AMORTIZATION THESIS - 'saturation = enough compiled reasoning that solving becomes traversal' - which is exactly what the benefit ladder tests; that projection is sign-robust because it is a frontier claim tested layer by layer, and its negatives (a layer whose compiled mechanism fails to beat the naive arm) are first-class. As a standalone headline it is an articulation, so its empirical content lives entirely in experiments owned elsewhere (benefit lane) or in the representation tournaments.
candidate_questions.field_need: Overlaps knowledge compilation, proof-assistant lemma amortization and case-based reasoning; the claimed delta (use-time certificates, typed fail-closed refusal, obstruction preservation, governed authority transport) is CANNOT_CHECK at nearest-work grade until the nearest-work lane verifies primaries - recorded honestly in docs/REASONING_LOCATION.md.
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: Strengthens the ledger's structure: the benefit column IS the amortization thesis's payoff column; the frame explains WHY soundness alone cannot carry the programme.

recommended_headline_question.statement: Where does the reasoning live, and which of its compiled obligations are load-bearing? PI-Q6 supplies the paper's question FRAME (reasoning relocated to compiled space / governed interfaces / failure analysis); PI-Q2's hypothesis-necessity audit is that frame's first executable instantiation at theorem level (which compiled obligations are individually necessary), and the representation tournament (REPRESENTATION_TOURNAMENT_PROTOCOL_V1.json, Contest 1) is its second at space level (is the compiled form the right container).
recommended_headline_question.selection_basis: Weighed per the operator addendum rather than appended: PI-Q6 alone is an articulation whose empirical content is owned by other lanes; PI-Q2 alone is executable but under-motivated as a headline. Composed, the frame supplies the field-facing question and PI-Q2/REP-C1 supply the sign-robust receipts this paper can execute itself. Non-compensatory reasoning; no scalar ranking. Weakness preserved honestly: the composed headline's nearest-work delta is CANNOT_CHECK until primary verification.

concrete_evidence_delta.name: hypothesis-necessity audit of formal/RaklFormal.lean
design: Tier A (mechanical, cheap): per headline theorem, per explicit hypothesis, generate a mutant file with the hypothesis removed from the signature; expect compile FAILURE (proof-necessity). A mutant that still compiles is a discovered simplification and promotes to Tier B immediately.

Tier B (mathematical): for each proof-necessary hypothesis, author an in-file countermodel lemma (same dependency-free style) exhibiting a model where the remaining hypotheses hold and the conclusion fails (statement-necessity). Follow the existing exemplar pattern (certified_operator_may_change_canon).
Tier C (report): a per-theorem, per-hypothesis necessity table appended under research/paper1_formal_closure/, cells NECESSARY_WITNESSED / DROPPABLE / PROOF_NECESSARY_ONLY.

Scope control: start with the headline set (no_faithful_scalarization, projection_collision, open_world_not_finitely_certifiable, no_uncertified_composition_changes_canon, stabilized_is_fixed/stabilized_is_least, the parity family) before sweeping all 87.
concrete_evidence_delta.runnability: CPU-only. Lean pin formal/lean-toolchain (leanprover/lean4:v4.14.0); CI installs elan on ubuntu-24.04 in minutes; the file is dependency-free (no mathlib) so each mutant compile is seconds. Tens of mutants for the headline set; hundreds for the full sweep. Feasible on laptop billy or as a CI job.
concrete_evidence_delta.chronology_rule: Freeze the theorem list and hypothesis enumeration before running any mutant; a mutant that unexpectedly compiles is recorded, never silently absorbed.

must_not_be_claimed: Proof-necessity (this proof breaks without hypothesis H) is NOT statement-necessity (the theorem is false without H). Only a countermodel earns 'necessary'.
Minimality of the formalization is NOT minimality of the deployed discipline; runtime gates may not be weakened on the basis of a DROPPABLE cell without separate governed review.
No benefit claim follows from any necessity result; the benefit column remains governed by the ledger and the benefit-saturation lane.
The 87-theorem count is a file count at commit 08169241, not a claim inventory; the claim-level mapping remains research/paper1_formal_closure/theorem_inventory.json (18 claims, 17 FULL / 1 PARTIAL).
